E.scope: Constant Atlas parameter; source API may vary with t,x. Bounds1Pa–1TPa are project exploration limits.

nu.scope: Constant Atlas parameter; -.99<=nu<=.499 is a project restriction inside -1<nu<.5 positive-definite range.

p_ref.scope: Not an elastic material parameter; no effect on exact stress update.

sigma.conversion: Source C=lambda*I_tensor_product_I+2G*I_sym equals K trace(de) I+2G dev(de). Both stress and strain signs reversed together. Mechanical strain increment in fixed frame.
sigma.scope: Constant-parameter, zero-spin infinitesimal stress residual. Not full OGS process equivalence.

e.source: Atlas project bookkeeping; not in OGS elasticity
e.conversion: (1+e_new)=(1+e_old)exp(-trace(de)); multiplicative composition for additive volumetric increments.
e.scope: Positive scalar bookkeeping only; exponential volume convention does not make the stress update finite-strain.

stress_scope_decision: Effective Cauchy stress is the Atlas soil-laboratory interpretation. The inspected stand-alone OGS material files expose mechanical stress, not a complete pore-pressure/effective-stress process. This declaration does not attribute an effective-stress coupling law to those files.

state_semantics_evidence.sigma: Persistent Cauchy stress offset; passive transformation Q sigma Q^T, source incremental stress storage. No finite-step transport.
state_semantics_evidence.e: Persistent Atlas scalar void ratio, invariant under passive basis changes; no stiffness coupling.

initialization_notes: Explicit sigma and e required; examples100kPaI,e=.7 do not describe a preparation history or calibrated specimen. e>0; tensile stress allowed. Missing state is rejected, not defaulted.

transactions.type: Incremental residual with committed sigma_n/e_n and supplied strain increment. No clock/duration or elapsed-time relaxation.
transactions.zero_load: sigma_new=sigma_old and e_new=e_old; arbitrary holds do not evolve state.
transactions.commit_rollback: Trial starts from committed input; successful increments commit both persistent fields, failure restores input. No yield event, reset or plastic multiplier.
transactions.subdivision: Constant elastic stress is additive; (1+e) bookkeeping is multiplicative for additive trace. Partition independence holds analytically, apart from numerical solution/rounding and domain failure.
transactions.tangent: Stress tangent C is constant for fixed E,nu. e derivative is -(1+e_new)trace(dde). Bulk/shear positivity holds for E>0,-1<nu<.5; near-incompressible conditioning is not guaranteed.

unsupported: varying E(t,x),nu(t,x), temperature or additional source process fields
poroelasticity, time-dependent relaxation or calibrated soil prediction
source equivalence for Atlas void-ratio state
